instruction: Apply a Neural Filter for style transfer to this image using GIMP.

metadata.explanation: Neural Filters are AI-powered filters exclusive to Adobe Photoshop that use cloud-based machine learning. GIMP does not have Neural Filters or any built-in AI/machine learning-based style transfer capabilities. While third-party plugins might exist, the task as stated referring to Neural Filters is infeasible in GIMP.
